title: 21st Day
data:
اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِىْ فِيْهِ اِلٰى مَرْضَاتِكَ دَلِيْلًا، وَ لَا تَجْعَلْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيْهِ عَلَىَّ سَبِيْلًا، وَ اجْعَلِ الْجَنَّةَ لِىْ مَنْزِلًا وَ مَقِيْلًا، يَا قَاضِىَ حَوَآئِجِ الطَّالِبِيْنَ.
ALLAAHUMMAJ A'L LEE FEEHE ELAA MARZAATEKA DALEELAN WA LAA TAJ-A'L LISH-SHAYTAANE FEEHE A'LAYYA SABEELAN WAJ A'LIL JANNATA LEE MANZELAN WA MAQEELAN YAA QAAZEYA HAWAA-EJIT TAALEBEENA.
O Allah, on this day, (please) make for me a course that takes me to Your pleasure, do not make for Satan a course to me, and make Paradise my home and dwelling. O He Who settles the needs of the beseechers!
